newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Aviation June traffic down.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Aviation June traffic down.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said Wednesday revenue passenger miles and available seat miles plunged in June, reflecting limited operations following a voluntary shutdown in May.
Passenger load factor for the month was 57.8 percent, up from 45.7 percent a year ago.
But revenue passenger miles were 6.8 million, down from 27.2 million a year ago, and available seat miles were 11.8 million, down from 59.6 million a year ago.
For the year through June, load factor was 42.9 percent, down from 44.3 percent a year ago, the regional airline said.
Revenue passenger miles were 108.3 million, down from 144.9 million a year ago and available seat miles were 252.2 million, down from 326.8 million a year ago.
Great Lakes shares were up 1/64 at 57/64 Wednesday.
